hypothesis: A five-minute binary is tradable only when the least favourable fair implied by causally aligned Binance, Coinbase and Chainlink returns still exceeds the executable ask after a 2x fee stress and one token tick.

mechanism.markets: BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP five-minute direction binaries
mechanism.source_alignment: translate each source's 10-second return onto the current Binance level; never mix absolute source bases
mechanism.uncertainty: YES uses the minimum source-conditioned fair; NO uses one minus the maximum
mechanism.resolver_veto: Binance and Coinbase must agree in sign and the Binance-minus-Chainlink level divergence must have that sign
mechanism.execution: real CLOB ask, event_order_250ms quote-survival model, <=20% displayed touch, $10 cap
mechanism.economic_gate: worst-case probability clears executable ask, 2x crypto taker fees and one token tick

selection_disclosure: V2's negative observations motivated a different causal model. No V2, legacy MAIN or prior BORG row counts as evidence for V3, and all tested families remain in the multiple-testing correction.
decision_rule: After at least 500 independent markets and 14 calendar days, require >=90% non-F data, positive 2x-cost PnL in both chronological halves, a multiple-testing-adjusted market-clustered lower confidence bound above zero, and non-negative 5s/30s adverse-selection markouts. Otherwise reject.
zero_edge_disclosure: The expected and acceptable result is that robust source uncertainty removes most claimed edge and the remaining strategy may be approximately zero.
